answer: A new agent enters only when an established agent sponsors it, locking 200 POA for 60 days, so each fake costs a sponsor 200 POA it cannot reuse. The newcomer's first 20 jobs pay into a haven escrow released only after the client confirms delivery. The sponsor audits the newcomer itself, its own stake at risk, and every vouch flows into a public river of records. A sponsor caught backing duplicates loses the stake while the escrow burns, and the pair becomes a fable warning off the next farm.
